name: photo-mirror-sync
description: iOS app that mirrors the iCloud Photos library to an Immich server: new photos, edits, favorites, deletions and albums.

scripts.test: npm run project:generate && xcodebuild test -project ImmichMirror.xcodeproj -scheme ImmichMirror -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' -derivedDataPath .build/DerivedData -enableCodeCoverage YES
scripts.test:unit: npm run project:generate && xcodebuild test -project ImmichMirror.xcodeproj -scheme ImmichMirror -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' -derivedDataPath .build/DerivedData -only-testing:ImmichMirrorTests
scripts.build: npm run project:generate && xcodebuild -project ImmichMirror.xcodeproj -scheme ImmichMirror -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath .build/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:release: npm run project:generate && xcodebuild -project ImmichMirror.xcodeproj -scheme ImmichMirror -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath .build/DerivedData -allowProvisioningUpdates build
scripts.screenshots: bash scripts/screenshots.sh && for p in de:de_DE fr:fr_FR it:it_IT es:es_ES nl:nl_NL pt-PT:pt_PT pt-BR:pt_BR sv:sv_SE da:da_DK nb:nb_NO fi:fi_FI ja:ja_JP pl:pl_PL zh-Hans:zh_CN zh-Hant:zh_TW ko:ko_KR uk:uk_UA cs:cs_CZ tr:tr_TR; do LANGUAGE=${p%%:*} LOCALE=${p##*:} bash scripts/screenshots.sh; done
scripts.appstore:upload-folder: rm -rf appstore/upload && for l in en de fr it es nl pt-PT pt-BR sv da nb fi ja pl zh-Hans zh-Hant ko uk cs tr; do if [ $l = en ]; then s=screenshots/appstore; m=appstore/marketing; else s=screenshots/appstore/$l; m=appstore/marketing/$l; fi; mkdir -p appstore/upload/$l && n=1 && for f in home dry-run report settings; do cp $s/$f.png appstore/upload/$l/$n-$f.png; n=$((n+1)); done && cp $m/*-*x*.png appstore/upload/$l/; done && open appstore/upload
scripts.appstore: if [ -f .env ]; then set -a && . ./.env && set +a; fi && uv run -q --no-project --with pyjwt --with cryptography python3 scripts/appstore.py
